title: Media file_path used in URLs without validation
description: activitypub.rs:711-713, media.rs:57, posting.rs:810-811. Media file_path values from the database are interpolated directly into URL paths (e.g., format\!("https://{domain}/media/{}", m.file_path)). If a file_path contained path traversal sequences like '../../../etc/passwd', it would generate a URL pointing to arbitrary files. The file_path is set during upload (media.rs:221, format 'media/{prefix}/{id}.{ext}') where prefix and id are hex/numeric and ext comes from sniff_mime validation, so current write paths are safe. But imported media (import.rs:391) uses the original filename's extension. An archive with a crafted filename could produce an unexpected file_path.
